characters.name: Terezka
characters.tag_prompt: child, brown hair, short hair, wetsuit, pebbles
characters.desc_en: Terezka, a small brave 7-year-old girl in a wetsuit who collects pebbles

characters.name: Bodlinka
characters.desc_en: Bodlinka, a hedgehog wearing a red scarf

characters.name: Kapitánka Iva
characters.tag_prompt: woman, captain, diving suit, short hair
characters.desc_en: Captain Iva, a friendly woman in a diving suit

characters.name: Želva Stovka
characters.desc_en: Stovka, a very old big sea turtle

locations.tag_prompt: underwater station, round windows, fish outside, map
locations.desc_en: A small station under the sea with round porthole windows, silver fish swimming outside.

locations.tag_prompt: underwater, coral reef, lanterns, colorful corals, bubbles
locations.desc_en: A coral reef lit by little lanterns, colours like a broken rainbow.
An old shipwreck behind the reef, old wheels sticking out of the wood.

panels.scene_en: a small underwater station with round porthole windows, silver fish swimming outside
Terezka glues together a map, a hedgehog in a red scarf sits beside her like a little captain without a ship

bubbles.speaker: terezka
bubbles.text: Když je želva Stovka smutná, plave do kruhu. A když plave do kruhu, najde… vrak.

panels.scene_en: Captain Iva raises a finger, Terezka grins

bubbles.speaker: iva
bubbles.text: Dobře, malá průzkumnice. Ale podmínka: držet se světla. A žádné sbírání „chrastících kamínků“ uprostřed proudu.

bubbles.speaker: terezka
bubbles.text: Jen tři. Možná čtyři. A jeden pro štěstí.

panels.scene_en: on the reef the old turtle swims in circles with bubbles shaped like question marks, a little pink octopus plays with a key stuck in coral
the hedgehog curls into a ball, Terezka sets it on the current, it rolls like a mini submarine, hits the coral and the key shoots upward

bubbles.speaker: terezka
bubbles.text: Bodlinko! Jsi nejrychlejší kámen na světě!

panels.scene_en: the turtle goes quiet and the old shipwreck behind the reef opens a little like a sleeping eye

bubbles.text: Vrak za útesem se pootevře jako spící oko.

panels.scene_en: Terezka places a pebble on the threshold of the wreck, the turtle touches it with its nose

bubbles.text: Terezka položí na práh kamínek, který „chrastí dobrodružstvím“.

panels.scene_en: inside the wreck a glass sphere with a tiny glowing plant like a moon vegetable

bubbles.speaker: terezka
bubbles.text: To je semínko útesu. Želva ho hlídala, dokud nepřijde někdo, kdo umí počkat.

panels.scene_en: Captain Iva smiles, the octopus plants the seed in the sand

bubbles.speaker: iva
bubbles.text: A někdo, kdo má ježka jako záchranný člun.

panels.scene_en: bubbles rise in the shape of a heart, the hedgehog sleeps on its folded scarf on three pebbles

bubbles.speaker: terezka
bubbles.text: Čtyři kamínky. Ten čtvrtý je Bodlinka.
